scope: Supplemental comparator-domain constructions; bridge prepares inputs and invokes original comparator, not synthetic semantic query results

cases.nil-and-intrinsic-creation: Create two same-flag any types in order; compare [nil,first,second] pairwise.
cases.foreign-checker: Compare first type with another live checker any type; exact panic message.
cases.duplicate-name-no-declarations: Two duplicate-name symbols with no declarations. First comparison visits second then first and mints lazy IDs; reverse and nil comparisons follow.
cases.reverse-mapped-no-symbol-or-mapper: Create two empty reverse-mapped records, compare pairwise without resolving members.
cases.deferred-source-location: Same interface target, different source statements, no mapper or alias.
cases.instantiation-expression-location: Two instantiation-expression comparator records with different source statements.
cases.nested-mapper-comparison: Nil, simple, array and recursively nested merged mappers; all pairwise outcomes. Finite mapper trees, not illegal cyclic mapper objects.
cases.deferred-same-location-mapper: Same target and source node; distinct nested merged mappers decide order.
cases.nil-node-order: Compare nil/non-nil nodes in both directions and nil with nil.
